test_title: PYST 1: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c84cc5f4a1cbcde15064d4b49a2a7ce5ef5440173c006ff6b8f36bd03a77877f.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For top left corner and bottom element : 

 
• Top left corner element → Shifting alternately to left center corner and bottom subsequently.
 
• Bottom element → Shifting alternately to second position from left center corner and top right corner subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e1cf575dc6a566721ff6a1c1b729298e99090858f06b8552b766dae9f02170c.png] 

2) For center element : 

 
• First element from left center corner → Shifting to fourth position from left center corner subsequently.
 
• Second element from left center corner → Shifting to first position from right center corner subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4978d7cb53e838c9baba1398eb53e877ec1daba5038be4224808b0a0256edec1.png] 

3) For center element : 

 
• Third element from left center corner → Shifting to bottom position subsequently.
 
• Fourth element from left center corner → Shifting to top right corner subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16210a8647e8c9059a3bb1c026c58a7b772fc281caca935842d19780fa1756cf.png] 

Final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13f23102c83284df5fad33f73c0191e883912fd3c88995f64c6fecc2669924a6.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
